en.topic_title: ‘No doubt’ of climate change role in deadly China-Nepal flood: scientists
en.topic_summary:
Climate change was a core factor in last month’s deadly glacial mountain collapse on the China-Nepal border that killed more than 1,400 people and left at least 6,600 missing, scientists said Thursday.



A man looks at the remains in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 7, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP.



However, scientists from the World Weather Attribution (WWA) group said, the disaster was not caused by a single extreme weather event
